theme.rationale: Courtside tactical bench scouting app: high ambient light in arenas requires sharp dark command-center aesthetic (#0B1120 / #0F172A) with intense luminous accents for rapid touch registration without eye strain.

typography.font_family_heading: Cabinet Grotesk, Barlow, Outfit, system-ui, sans-serif
typography.font_family_body: IBM Plex Sans, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, Segoe UI, sans-serif
typography.font_family_mono: IBM Plex Mono, JetBrains Mono, monospace

layout_and_grids.concept: Bench-Ready Command Center (Landscape Tablet & Desktop optimized)

tablet_layout_structure.header: Sticky top bar: Home vs Away names (editable inline), Scoreboard (Home PTS vs Opponent PTS), Period selector (Q1, Q2, Q3, Q4, OT), Home/Away toggle badge, Opponent quick score buttons (+1, +2, +3) with instant visual ripple, and Save/Report nav buttons.
tablet_layout_structure.main_grid: 3-column tactical dashboard on md/lg: Left (Roster 20 players, filter All/5 In Campo, quick switch, foul badges), Center (Clickable SVG Basketball Half-Court with Made/Missed toggle + 2PT/3PT auto-detector depending on click distance, shot marker log, undo shot button), Right (Tactical stats pad for active player: PTS, +/-, PF, RO, RD, TO, STL, AST, BLK, FT made/miss, DF received foul, plus quick quick substitution button).

layout_and_grids.mobile_portrait_adaptation: Tabbed dock on mobile/portrait tablet: [Tab 1: Campo/Tiro, Tab 2: Roster 5/20, Tab 3: Statistiche & Boxscore, Tab 4: Report AI & PDF].

svg_half_court_spec.parquet_base: #B45309 with subtle horizontal wood grain lines (#92400E)
svg_half_court_spec.key_three_point_distance: Arc radius approximately 320 units centered on hoop (250, 420). If click distance > 320 => tagged 3PT (3 pts if made), else 2PT (2 pts if made). Free throw clicks in key are counted or logged.

shot_markers.made: Solid circle with checkmark/center ring, colored by current Quarter color
shot_markers.missed: Cross 'X' marker in danger red or dimmed quarter hue with strokeWidth 3
shot_markers.animation: Subtle scale pop on placement (scale 0.5 to 1.0, duration 0.2s)

boxscore_and_report_spec.team_boxscore_table: Dense responsive table: # (Number), Giocatore (Cognome N.), Status (5 in campo badge), MIN/Quarti, PTS, T2 (Segnati/Tentati, %), T3, TL, TIRI TOT, RO, RD, RT, AST, TO, STL, BLK, PF, DF, +/-.
boxscore_and_report_spec.charts: Recharts Points per Quarter bar chart, Shot distribution (2PT vs 3PT vs FT pie or donut), Shot efficiency map with quarter filter.
boxscore_and_report_spec.ai_analysis_section: Modern card with AI Coach Insights: Quarter-by-quarter momentum breakdown, Defensive impact rating (+/-), Top performer spotlight, Bench vs Starters scoring delta, and Tactical recommendations (e.g. Turnovers in Q3, 3PT shot selection).

component_guidelines.scoreboard_widget: Large high-contrast display with Home Team (custom name) vs Away Team (custom name), Casa/Trasferta indicator, Live Total, Opponent points adder with prompt toast feedback.
component_guidelines.player_card_roster: Compact card with # badge, Cognome & Nome, 5 IN CAMPO indicator with toggle switch, current fouls (visual dots 1-5, red alert on 5 fouls), PTS and +/- badge.
component_guidelines.court_controller: Segnato/Sbagliato toggle (Green 'Segnato' button / Red 'Sbagliato' button with high tactile contrast), Quarto selector tabs (Q1-OT with dedicated badge color), Annulla Ultimo Tiro (Undo) with count badge.
component_guidelines.stat_counter_button: Big touch target (>48px) with quick tap +1 and long-press or '-' to decrement, haptic vibration fallback if supported, tactile border.

instructions_to_main_agent: Build the complete application with React and FastAPI backend.

Preserve the authentic Italian basketball scout sheet nomenclature (IN CAMPO, PANCHINA, Segnato, Sbagliato, Falli PF, Rimbalzi RO/RD, Perse TO, Recuperi STL, Assist AST, Stoppate BLK, Tiri Liberi TL, Falli Subiti DF, Valutazione, +/-).
Keep the match data persistent in backend database (MongoDB/FastAPI) so users can create, edit names/venue/date, save live actions, reopen past matches, and export clean print PDF.
Implement the AI Match Analysis report using LLM integration on backend (or smart analytics engine fallback when offline) to produce genuine tactical coaching notes.
Enable full in-place editing of Home and Away team names, match date, location, and Casa/Fuori Casa (Home/Away game toggle).

Ensure every clickable button, input, toggle, and critical table cell has unique `data-testid` attributes (e.g. data-testid='scoreboard-home-score', data-testid='player-item-0', data-testid='court-shot-svg', data-testid='btn-add-stat-ast', data-testid='toggle-in-campo-0', data-testid='export-pdf-btn').
Support sound / tactile feedback toggle and high-contrast courtside mode for outdoor or brightly lit sports arenas.

image_urls.description: Atmospheric illuminated indoor basketball court hardwood floor with arena lighting for dashboard headers and empty states
Wide shot of basketball pavilion hardwood court with grandstands for match report cover

UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT.avoid_ai_slop: Use sharp courtside tactile aesthetics: dark slate matte surfaces (#0B1120, #0F172A), amber parquet half-court (#B45309), high-contrast electric accents. Do NOT use soft pastel generic gradients.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT.tactile_controls: Buttons used during play (shot markers, stats +1, undo, opponent score) must have generous touch targets (min 44px-52px height) for fast fingers on a tablet without mis-clicks.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT.accessibility: Ensure all text on dark slate and on parquet court exceeds APCA/WCAG contrast ratios with crisp text-shadow or solid contrasting badges.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT.testing_readiness: All interactive triggers and metric badges must include distinct data-testid tags.
